subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this remaining bug be fixed narrowly in Telegram plain-group route persistence, through a shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, or through a staged combination of both?
rationale: The visible source gap is Telegram-specific, but related Mattermost/session reports show adjacent non-direct delivery-context failures where a shared fallback could alter cross-channel routing behavior.

options.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
options.body: Persist the Telegram plain-group last route and prove the reported restart/session-history path without broadening shared fallback behavior yet.

options.title: Adopt a shared fallback
options.body: Refresh or replace the shared fallback PR after compatibility review and cross-channel proof for non-direct session routing.

options.title: Block on live repro
options.body: Keep this issue waiting for a live current-main Telegram restart reproduction before choosing the implementation boundary.

recommendation.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
recommendation.body: Persist the Telegram plain-group last route and prove the reported restart/session-history path without broadening shared fallback behavior yet.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder history and session-store behavior where this handle has the strongest feature-history signal.
